t: The khanate of Jochi's descendants, founded by Batu after the Mongol conquest of the western steppe and Rus' in 1236–1242.
From Sarai on the Volga its khans took tribute from the Rus' princes and traded with Genoese Crimea, Central Asia and Egypt.
Civil war after 1359 and Timur's campaigns broke it into the khanates of Kazan, Crimea and Astrakhan and the Great Horde.
dyk: The name Golden Horde was coined by Russian writers centuries later; contemporaries called the state the Ulus of Jochi, after Genghis Khan's eldest son.
ev: Batu withdraws to the lower Volga and establishes his ulus
Uzbek Khan begins a reign in which Islam becomes the state religion
Plague strikes Janibeg's army besieging Caffa
Dmitry of Moscow defeats Mamai at the Battle of Kulikovo
Timur defeats Tokhtamysh on the Terek and sacks Sarai
The Great Stand on the Ugra River ends Moscow's tribute
Meñli I Giray of Crimea defeats the last khan and sacks Sarai

f.successor: Khanate of Kazan; Crimean Khanate; Khanate of Astrakhan; Great Horde
